rates.title: Local Moving Rates
rates.subtitle: $125/hour flat rate — most local moves cost $400–$900 depending on size, stairs, and distance.

items.question: How long does a local move take?
items.answer: A studio or 1-bedroom typically takes 2-3 hours. A 2-3 bedroom home takes 4-6 hours. Larger homes may take a full day.

items.question: Do I need to pack everything before you arrive?
items.answer: No — you can add packing services to your move. We offer professional packing with quality materials. Or you can pack yourself and we handle the loading and transport.

items.question: Can you move just a few items?
items.answer: Yes. We handle single-item moves like couches, dressers, or appliances. The 3-hour minimum still applies.

items.question: What if I’m moving to or from an apartment?
items.answer: No problem. We move apartments, condos, townhomes, and houses. No extra charge for stairs or elevators.

items.question: Do you move on weekends?
items.answer: Yes, we’re available Monday through Sunday, 8 AM to 6 PM.
